## Unit Summary

This unit provides a comprehensive introduction to data visualisation, developing critical thinking and problem-solving skills for interpreting, evaluating and creating visualisations using contemporary tools.  Topics include foundational design principles, choosing appropriate visualisations for different data types, single-variable and multivariable plots, and data wrangling for cleaning datasets. You will engage in iterative refinement, visual storytelling, and designing inclusive, accessible visualisations that consider diverse audiences. Advanced topics such as interactivity and animation are also covered. Combined with hands-on practice and real-world business applications, this equips you to communicate data-driven insights effectively in your future career.

## Learning outcomes

1. Critique data visualisations using principles of graphical excellence, sound design judgement, and statistical thinking

2. Create data visualisations from complex data sets using contemporary technologies for business applications

3. Communicate data-driven insights tailored for audience, message and medium

4. Design interactive data visualisations and animations for data discovery and communication of complex dynamic patterns.

5. Formulate research questions from a data set with exploratory data analysis.

6. Design inclusive and accessible data visualisations for audiences with diverse perspectives, identities, skills and abilities
